author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
[IPR001345](http://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/IPR001345)

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Q7KS61

* **Description of issue**
IPR001345 is annotated with the high level term '[catalytic activity (GO:0003824)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO:0003824)'. This isn't very informative and, for Q7KS61/FBgn0038957 at least, it is wrong.
Could it be removed?
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR001345

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi Steven,
Thank you for flagging this. I removed this mapping. The changes will be available in the next InterPro release.
Best,
Beatriz
